chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Malik ibn Atiyya, from Abu Ubayda, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:
We found in the Book of Ali (peace be upon him) that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'When adultery becomes abundant after me, sudden death will become abundant.'
ai.seo_question: What is the connection between adultery and sudden death in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in Al-Kafi, this hadith traces its chain to Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him), who cites a tradition from the Prophet found in the 'Book of Ali,' establishing a causal link between societal moral decay (zina) and sudden death (mawt al-faj'a). In Shia exegesis, this is viewed not merely as a physical phenomenon but as a divine punishment where the soul is snatched before repentance can occur, serving as a spiritual warning to the community.
